_comment: Запас опытов для GPU-генерации (tools/gpu-queue.md, п. 5). Сайт этот файл НЕ читает: опыт попадает в «Эффектные опыты» только после приёмки ролика — перенести запись в video-prompts.json, файл — в app/static/video/chem/<id>.mp4 и прогнать test_lab_videos (варианты ответа без двойников по цвету). Полный промпт = prompt + style + avoid из video-prompts.json. Химию сверять перед переносом.

items.title: «Дым без огня»: аммиак и хлороводород
items.prompt: Two small open glass bottles stand side by side on the bench: one with concentrated ammonia solution, one with concentrated hydrochloric acid, both clear and colourless. A gloved hand holds two glass rods, one moistened from each bottle, and brings their tips close together in the air without touching. Dense white smoke appears between the rod tips and slowly drifts upward. Smoke is allowed in this clip.

items.title: Оксид меди(II) в серной кислоте
items.observe: чёрный порошок растворяется, раствор становится голубым
items.prompt: A test tube with a small amount of black copper(II) oxide powder under clear colourless dilute sulfuric acid is gently warmed in a tube holder over a small spirit-lamp flame. The black powder gradually dissolves and the liquid turns a clear light blue. Small flame allowed in this clip.

items.title: Железо в соляной кислоте
items.observe: медленное выделение газа, раствор слегка зеленеет
items.prompt: A test tube with clear colourless hydrochloric acid. Tongs drop a small pinch of grey iron filings into it. Small colourless gas bubbles slowly and steadily rise from the iron, much calmer than with zinc; over the clip the liquid takes on a very pale green tint.

items.title: Растворение гидроксида железа(III) в кислоте
items.prompt: A test tube with a rusty red-brown flaky iron(III) hydroxide precipitate in water. A dropper adds clear colourless hydrochloric acid. The brown precipitate dissolves and disappears, leaving a clear transparent yellow-brown solution without any solid.

items.title: Серебряное дерево на медной проволоке
items.observe: серебристые кристаллы на меди, раствор голубеет
items.prompt: A small glass beaker with a clear colourless silver nitrate solution. A coil of shiny reddish copper wire is lowered into it. Time-lapse feel: fine shiny silvery-grey needle crystals grow on the copper like a frosty tree, and the colourless liquid slowly turns pale blue.

items.title: Перманганат калия в кислой среде
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear deep purple potassium permanganate solution acidified with sulfuric acid. A dropper adds a clear colourless sodium sulfite solution. The purple colour quickly fades and the liquid becomes completely colourless and clear, no precipitate.

items.title: Перманганат калия в нейтральной среде
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear deep purple potassium permanganate solution in water. A dropper adds a clear colourless sodium sulfite solution. The purple colour fades and a dark brown cloudy precipitate forms and slowly settles.

items.title: Перманганат калия в щелочной среде
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear deep purple potassium permanganate solution mixed with colourless potassium hydroxide solution. A dropper adds a few drops of a clear colourless sodium sulfite solution. The purple liquid turns into a clear dark green solution, no precipitate.

items.title: Разложение пероксида водорода
items.observe: бурное выделение газа, тлеющая лучинка вспыхивает
items.prompt: A test tube with clear colourless hydrogen peroxide solution. A tiny pinch of black manganese dioxide powder is added: vigorous fizzing of colourless gas bubbles starts at once. A wooden splint with a glowing red tip is lowered into the mouth of the tube and bursts into a bright small flame. Small flame allowed in this clip.

items.title: Гидролиз соды: фенолфталеин
items.observe: раствор соли окрашивается в малиновый цвет
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear colourless sodium carbonate solution. A dropper with clear colourless phenolphthalein indicator adds two drops; the liquid inside the dropper stays colourless. The solution in the tube turns pink-crimson.

items.title: Амфотерность гидроксида алюминия
items.observe: белый осадок растворяется в избытке щёлочи
items.prompt: A test tube with clear colourless aluminium chloride solution. A dropper adds colourless sodium hydroxide solution a little at a time: first a white gelatinous precipitate forms; as more sodium hydroxide is added, the white precipitate dissolves completely and the liquid becomes clear and colourless again.

items.title: Жёлтый осадок фосфата серебра
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear colourless sodium phosphate solution. A dropper adds clear colourless silver nitrate solution. A bright yellow precipitate forms at once and spreads through the liquid as an opaque yellow suspension.

items.title: Качественная реакция на Fe³⁺: роданид
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear pale yellow iron(III) chloride solution. A dropper adds a few drops of clear colourless potassium thiocyanate solution. The liquid immediately turns an intense deep blood-red colour throughout, clear without precipitate.

items.title: Берлинская лазурь: Fe³⁺ и жёлтая кровяная соль
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear pale yellow iron(III) chloride solution. A dropper adds a few drops of a clear pale yellow potassium hexacyanoferrate(II) solution. An intense dark blue precipitate forms immediately and colours the whole liquid deep Prussian blue.

items.title: Окисление этанола оксидом меди(II)
items.prompt: A spiral of copper wire is heated in a small spirit-lamp flame until its surface turns black, then it is quickly dipped into a test tube with a little clear colourless ethanol. Within a second the black coating disappears and the wire becomes shiny reddish copper again. Small flame allowed in this clip.

items.title: Жёсткая вода и мыло
items.observe: мыло не пенится, образуются белые хлопья
items.prompt: Two test tubes side by side in a rack. Left tube: clear distilled water; right tube: clear water with dissolved calcium chloride. A dropper adds the same amount of soap solution to each and both are shaken. The left tube fills with abundant white foam; the right tube gives almost no foam and white curd-like flakes float in it.
